result.summary: The page renders mostly correctly, but the bottom navigation overlaps the home indicator and its icons collide, and a 'Popular right now' promo card appears mis-sized/clipped on the right.

issues.description: The bottom navigation bar is misaligned: the search icon and the bookmark icon overlap with the black home-indicator bar, and the icons are not evenly spaced.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom safe-area padding to the navigation bar and lay out the four icons in a evenly spaced row so they clear the home indicator.

issues.description: The right side of the 'Popular right now' card is clipped, so the card's rounded right edge is missing and the image looks cut off mid-element rather than fully rendered.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the promotional card is inset within the screen margins and its corner radii are applied on both sides.
